mapper.select: SELECT t1.CORP_GR , TO_CHAR(t1.TR_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS tr_ymd , t1.TR_CD , t1.FUND_CD , t1.TRUSTEE , t1.CURRENCY , t1.TR_SEQ , t1.TR_AEK , t1.WON_TR_AEK , t1.BAL_AEK , t1.WON_BAL_AEK , t1.TAX_AEK , TO_CHAR(t1.GYULJE_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS gyulje_ymd , ia.FUND_NM AS xx_fund_cd , ia.FUND_CURRENCY , t1.FCUR_TR_AEK , t1.FCUR_BAL_AEK , 1 AS p_visible , t1.FUND_CD AS orig_fund_cd , t1.TRUSTEE AS orig_trustee , t1.CURRENCY AS orig_currency , t1.TR_SEQ AS orig_tr_seq , TO_CHAR(t1.GYULJE_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS orig_gyulje_ymd FROM SYT0MA t1 JOIN SZM0IA ia ON ia.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND ia.FUND_CD = t1.FUND_CD WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.TR_YMD = TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{trYmd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND t1.TR_CD = #{trCd} ORDER BY t1.FUND_CD ASC , t1.TRUSTEE ASC , t1.CURRENCY ASC , t1.TR_SEQ ASC

SELECT t1.FUND_CD AS fundCd , ia.FUND_NM AS fundNm , t1.TRUSTEE AS trustee , t1.CURRENCY AS currency , ia.FUND_CURRENCY AS fundCurrency , TO_CHAR(ia.HAEJI_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS haejiYmd , COALESCE(t1.BFIL_AEK, 0) + COALESCE(t1.UP_AEK, 0) - COALESCE(t1.DW_AEK, 0) AS balAek , COALESCE(t1.WON_BFIL_AEK, 0) + COALESCE(t1.WON_UP_AEK, 0) - COALESCE(t1.WON_DW_AEK, 0) AS wonBalAek , COALESCE(t1.FCUR_BFIL_AEK, 0) + COALESCE(t1.FCUR_UP_AEK, 0) - COALESCE(t1.FCUR_DW_AEK, 0) AS fcurBalAek FROM SYT0MC t1 JOIN SZM0IA ia ON ia.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND ia.FUND_CD = t1.FUND_CD WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.TR_YMD = LAST_DAY(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{trYmd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD'), -2)) AND t1.TR_CD = CASE #{trCd} WHEN 'H21' THEN 'P40' WHEN 'H22' THEN 'P41' END ORDER BY t1.FUND_CD ASC , t1.TRUSTEE ASC , t1.CURRENCY ASC

SELECT DISTINCT TO_CHAR(t1.TR_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ymd FROM SYT0MA t1 WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.TR_CD IN ( SELECT ta.TR_CD FROM SZX1PT ta WHERE ta.OBJ_ID IN ('W_JA035N', 'W_SJA035N') ) ORDER BY ymd
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM SYT0MA WHERE CORP_GR = #{corpGr, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND TR_YMD = TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{trYmd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND TR_CD = #{trCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND FUND_CD = COALESCE(#{origFundCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{fundCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND TRUSTEE = COALESCE(#{origTrustee, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{trustee, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND CURRENCY = COALESCE(#{origCurrency, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{currency, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND TR_SEQ = COALESCE(#{origTrSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{trSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC}) AND GYULJE_YMD = TO_DATE(REPLACE(COALESCE(#{origGyuljeYmd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{gyuljeYmd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}), '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD')
